a261028p1.summary: TAIPEI — Leading PC makers, including HP of the U.S. and Asus and Acer of Taiwan, are combating soaring component costs by shifting …
a261028p1.title: Sources: HP, Asus, and Acer are shifting some PC production from Thailand and Vietnam back to China amid rising component costs; Dell is mulling a similar move (Nikkei Asia)

a261028p2.summary: The company's estimated market opportunity, tied to the economic value of work produced by knowledge workers, tops SpaceX's enormous figure from earlier this year
a261028p2.title: Anthropic's S-1 implies a $40T+ annual TAM based on the economic value of knowledge work in 2025, topping SpaceX's $28.5T estimate, without explicitly naming it (Wall Street Journal)

a261028p3.summary: TOKYO — Fujifilm will raise production capacity for magnetic tape fivefold to meet artificial-intelligence-driven demand …
a261028p3.title: Sources: Fujifilm plans to increase magnetic tape production capacity fivefold to meet AI-driven storage demand, its biggest production expansion in ~20 years (Nikkei Asia)

a261028p4.summary: Jio Platforms' shares rose 21.4% on their trading debut Wednesday after a record initial public offering that was lapped up by retail as well as institutional investors.
a261028p4.title: Jio Platforms, India's largest telecom and digital services company, rose 21.4% in its trading debut after raising ~$3.2B in the country's largest IPO (Priyanka Salve/CNBC)

a261028p5.summary: China's CXMT plans to start production of HBM3E, an advanced type of high-bandwidth memory chip used with AI processors …
a261028p5.title: Sources: CXMT plans to start HBM3E production despite yields of just 20% to 30%; its HBM3E performance is closer to that of SK Hynix's previous-gen HBM3 chips (Reuters)

a261028p6.summary: TAIPEI — As executives at PC makers, including HP and Dell, map out their supply needs for 2027, a mundane component has emerged as an unlikely concern.
a261028p6.title: Industry insiders say PCBs and chip substrates are key supply constraints for consumer electronics makers as AI demand increasingly eats up production capacity (Nikkei Asia)

a261028p7.summary: US private capital group in talks with Elliott over what would be among the booming sector's biggest deals this year
a261028p7.title: Sources: TPG is in talks to acquire UK-based Ark Data Centres, which operates 27 data centers in the UK and Belgium, from Elliott Management at a ~$5B valuation (Financial Times)
